name: Leadrove
meaning: Lead + rove: explore a neighborhood and find potential clients.
scope: Name, logo and existing app branding; the workspace layout is maintained separately.
mark: A custom L/R ligature joining the two parts of Leadrove's name: a curved L alongside an open R with a forward diagonal. Consistent stroke weight and a clear central channel keep the compact monogram readable at favicon sizes.

wordmark.spacing: Custom optical spacing at a 44-unit type scale, with 0.7 units removed from glyph advances.
wordmark.format: Outlined SVG paths; no font loading required

compatibility: Retain cf:* browser storage, .clientfinder/ report paths, CLIENTFINDER_* environment variables and the configured hosted origin.

provenance.mark: Custom authored SVG contours, developed from four original L/R studies. No stock symbol, traced brand asset or generated raster.
provenance.wordmark: Manrope variable font from google/fonts, instantiated at weight 750, spaced and converted to outlines using fontTools.
provenance.appIcon: Chromium render of the inverse L/R monogram on a full #204C46 square at 180 x 180; the platform supplies corner masking.
provenance.preview: Chromium render of the SVG brand assets and HTML at 1440 x 900; no generative imagery.
provenance.faviconFallbacks: Chromium renders of public/brand/leadrove-favicon.svg at 16, 32 and 48 pixels; the ICO contains all three PNG frames.
